reader_summary.headline: Steve Rattner is the Chairman and CEO of Willett Advisors.
reader_summary.overview: Steve Rattner is the Chairman and CEO of Willett Advisors, which invests former New York Mayor Michael Bloomberg's personal and philanthropic assets. Steve's career has ranged from a journalist for the New York Times to investment banking at Lehman Brothers, Morgan Stanley and Lazard Freres. He returned to oversee Willett Advisors after his work in the government.

key_points.text: Steve's career has ranged from a journalist for the New York Times to investment banking at Lehman Brothers, Morgan Stanley and Lazard Freres.
Our conversations starts with a quick tour through each of Steve's careers.
We close with Steve's perspectives on China and his ongoing engagement in politics.
